conditions.comparison: Exact 67b4 baseline helper temporarily installed versus candidate helper, both using extended routing and the unchanged A6 reader on one clean candidate checkout.
deviations_from_frozen_harness: Remove legacy routing; select two exact helper implementations for the same extended route.
Pin the accepted A6 reader and baseline67 helper within the candidate checkout.
Separate private construction, fresh compilation, and source projection categories with explicit dispatch naming.
Retain actual private inputs/buffer references for byte and mutable-identity checks after timers and wrappers exit.
Retain actual observer completion/emission counts and original failures without adding product operations.
conditions.diagnostic_retention: Diagnostic passes retain decoded projections, deepcopy inputs and owned byte-buffer references for post-run identity checks. Their memory behavior is intentionally unrepresentative; categories include hook/receipt overhead. Plain elapsed passes retain none of these diagnostic references.
conditions.excluded: Imports, baseline-module construction, input decoding/copying, canonical equality and private-object checks, report serialization, and product execution.
conditions.instrumented_categories: Exclusive stack timers only in the diagnostic pass; the residual category includes observer bookkeeping, dispatch, and measurement overhead.
conditions.memory_scope: Exact lengths/counts of owned immutable byte buffers only. Mutable-container identity inventories are checked after timing. No allocator, peak-memory, tracemalloc, or RSS measurement is made.
conditions.pause_scope: Recorder.paused runs with empty dbs and native_recorder=None; populated product pause/resource accounting is not reproduced.
conditions.primitive_instrumentation: Actual observe_replay wrappers are installed and restored with recording=False; literal primitive observations are not remeasured.
conditions.private_construction_scope: Union/header envelope encoding, actual private JSON decoding, and each _projection call. Admission row encodings also serve existing digest obligations and are counted once under source/digest verification.
conditions.scope: Owner admission, actual Native metadata constructor, actual observer setup/completion, Core emitters, former validation sites, seals, all flushes, and owner release.
conditions.workload: Literal retained samples and event order from three actual tiny caller turns; no product bodies are called.
